description: Create a collection for the signed-in person and return it. A smart collection (is_smart true) needs criteria with a list_type rule, for example { "logic": "and", "filters": [{ "field": "list_type", "operator": "eq", "value": "inventory" }, { "field": "category", "operator": "eq", "value": "Clothing" }] }. list_type is one of inventory (things the person owns), wishlist, lent, borrowed or archived. Without that rule nothing is created.
name: create_collection
title: Create collection
